tasks.Count_Legos_1: Calculate the number of lego pieces from the first box set (500 pieces).
tasks.Count_Legos_2: Calculate the number of lego pieces from the second box set (3 times more than the first, so 3 * 500 = 1500 pieces).
tasks.Count_Legos_3: Calculate the number of lego pieces from the third box set (1/4 the number of pieces in the first box set, so 500 / 4 = 125 pieces).
tasks.Sum_Legos: Calculate the total number of lego pieces Johnny picks up by summing the results from Count_Legos_1, Count_Legos_2, and Count_Legos_3.
